notes: «حَدَّثَني مَن سَمِعَ الحَسَن بْنِ مُحَمَّد النُّوفَلِيِّ» : the unnamed «من سمع» is a gap (rule 8) before the named Hasan, whose own story («يقول لما قدم») makes him a link.

The Imam named in Nawfali's story («عِنْدَ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ») speaks throughout the debate, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5). Yasir, al-Fadl and the debaters are in the scene, not links.
